title: Design System: Valeria de la Torre

display.purpose: Hero line only: roman first line, italic second line.

headline.purpose: Italic section titles; TEDx title steps down to clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px).

quote.purpose: Mujica pull-quote and form success message, italic.

body.purpose: Talk/TED descriptions and contact intro; 14px and hyphenated-justified on phones.

label.purpose: Uppercase whisper labels: eyebrows, form labels, buttons, toggle, audience lines.

shadows.name: media-icon
shadows.purpose: Legibility of the white play icon over the TEDx thumbnail only.

shadows.name: media-text
shadows.purpose: Legibility of the white 'Coming soon' text over photography only.

shadows.name: frosted-bar
shadows.purpose: Mobile fixed CTA bar; the only layered surface.

motion.name: transition-base
motion.purpose: Color, opacity and border shifts on buttons, links, toggle, inputs.

motion.name: transition-surface
motion.purpose: Talk-card fill to Sand; TED thumbnail opacity.

motion.name: transition-image-zoom
motion.purpose: Photo zoom inside talk cards on hover.

motion.name: brand-glide
motion.purpose: Continuous brand carousel; pauses on hover, touch-scrubbable.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid, assertive element: Ink fill that turns Ember on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--black, #0D0D0D); color: var(--white, #FFFFFF); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Jost', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 15px 32px; border-radius: 2px; border: none; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-dark, #A33E1A); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #C8522A); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Submit Button
components.description: Full-width form submit; same voice as Primary, larger padding.
components.css: .ds-btn-submit { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; background: var(--black, #0D0D0D); color: var(--white, #FFFFFF); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Jost', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 18px 48px; border-radius: 2px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-submit:hover { background: var(--accent-dark, #A33E1A); } .ds-btn-submit:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #C8522A); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-submit:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Link CTA
components.description: Bare uppercase label with an arrow that nudges right and turns Ember on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--black, #0D0D0D); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Jost', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-link::after { content: '→'; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0; transition: transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-link:hover { color: var(--accent-dark, #A33E1A); } .ds-btn-link:hover::after { transform: translateX(5px); } .ds-btn-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #C8522A); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: Outlined hairline pill in the fixed header; fills Ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-lang-toggle { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(13,13,13,0.25); color: var(--black, #0D0D0D); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Jost', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-lang-toggle:hover { background: var(--black, #0D0D0D); border-color: var(--black, #0D0D0D); color: var(--white, #FFFFFF); } .ds-lang-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #C8522A); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: Boxless field: whisper label above, Dune underline that darkens to Ink on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Jost', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gray-mid, #6B655E); } .ds-field-input { background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-line, #8A847D); color: var(--black, #0D0D0D); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Jost', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 300; padding: 12px 0; border-radius: 0; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-mid, #6B655E); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--black, #0D0D0D); }

components.name: Talk Card
components.description: Square White card, full-bleed photo, editorial stack; fill shifts to Sand on hover.

components.css: .ds-talk-card { background: var(--white, #FFFFFF); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; max-width: 420px; transition: background-color 300ms ease; } .ds-talk-card:hover { background: var(--sand, #EDE8E0); } .ds-talk-photo { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--sand-dark, #DDD6CB); } .ds-talk-body { padding: 36px 48px 48px; } .ds-talk-label { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Jost', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gray-mid, #6B655E); margin: 0 0 20px; } .ds-talk-title { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif); font-size: 34px; font-weight: 300; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--black, #0D0D0D); margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-talk-desc { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Jost', sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--gray-mid, #6B655E); margin: 0 0 20px; } .ds-talk-audience { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Jost', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gray-mid, #6B655E); border-top: 1px solid var(--sand, #EDE8E0); padding-top: 20px; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: Whisper eyebrow over a light italic Cormorant headline.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: block; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Jost', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gray-mid, #6B655E); margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-headline { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif); font-size: clamp(42px, 5.5vw, 72px); font-weight: 300; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.06; color: var(--black, #0D0D0D); margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Professional enough that a conference organizer trusts it, and warm enough that it feels like Val. The site is laid out like a fashion or culture magazine: large light italic serif headlines, generous white space, small uppercase labels with wide letter-spacing, and photography given full-bleed room. All of that sits on warm paper instead of cold white, speaks in the first person, and ends with her handwritten signature. The editorial structure provides the trust and the warmth comes from the paper, the voice and the signature. Neither should take over from the other.

Density is low and pacing is slow. Each section is a single idea with plenty of air (120px vertical padding on desktop). Sections are separated by stepping the background tone (paper, white, sand) rather than by rules or cards. Color is almost absent: the palette is warm neutrals and near-black, plus one terracotta ember used sparingly. Motion is quiet. Content fades up gently on scroll, the brand logos glide slowly, and hovers shift color without lifting anything.
keyCharacteristics: Light (300) Cormorant Garamond for every heading, usually italic.
Jost Light for body text, with tiny uppercase Jost Medium labels at about 0.2em tracking.
Warm paper neutrals; the near-black `#0D0D0D` stands in for pure black.
One accent, Terracotta Ember, used as a mark and a hover response and never as a fill area.
Corners are square or nearly square (0–2px). There are no shadows on surfaces.
Split and two-column editorial layouts that collapse to a single column on phones, with a fixed CTA bar at the bottom.

rules.name: The Single Ember Rule
rules.body: Terracotta Ember is the only hue on the page apart from photography and, on hover only, the brand logos. It appears as a hairline, a dot or a hover state. If it ever covers a surface larger than a button, it has gone too far.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: Sections are separated by changing the background (Paper → White → Paper → Dune → White → Paper), not by cards, shadows or heavy rules.

rules.name: The Light Hand Rule
rules.body: Serif headings are always weight 300 and section titles are always italic. Bold serif is not part of this system. Emphasis comes from size and italic, not weight.

rules.name: The Whisper Label Rule
rules.body: Every piece of UI chrome (labels, buttons, toggles, eyebrows) is tiny uppercase Jost Medium with wide tracking. Sentence-case UI text does not appear.

rules.name: The Paper Stays Flat Rule
rules.body: Cards, buttons and inputs never get a box-shadow. Hover is shown by a color shift (Ink → Ember, White → Sand), a slight image zoom (1.03) or an arrow nudge, never by lifting.

dos: Do set every serif heading in Cormorant Garamond at weight 300, and section titles in italic.
Do write all UI chrome as 11px uppercase Jost Medium with 0.12–0.24em tracking. Never go below 11px.
Do use Terracotta Ember only as a hairline, a dot or the focus ring, and Deep Ember for hover fills, link hovers and errors.
Do separate sections by stepping the background through Paper, White, Sand and Dune.
Do keep corners at 0px for surfaces and photos and 2px for buttons.
Do show hover through color, a 1.03 image zoom or a 5px arrow nudge, on 200ms ease timing (300–400ms for card fills and photos).
Do fade content up 28px over 0.7s on scroll, and turn this off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep side margins at exactly 20px on phones across every section.
Do close the page with her signature (`firma-val.png`) in grayscale at low opacity.
donts: Don't add box-shadows to cards, buttons or inputs. The paper stays flat.
Don't introduce a second accent color or fill large areas with Ember.
Don't use bold or semibold serif headings.
Don't use pure `#000` or cold pure-white page backgrounds. Paper (`#F7F5F2`) is the base and White is the alternate.
Don't draw inputs as boxes. Fields are underlines.
Don't round corners beyond 2px, except the play icon.
Don't set text in Pale Stone or with opacity-faded black. Text uses Stone or darker.
